profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | The Aerospace Corporation
profile.summary: I’m a full-stack engineer with 8 year of professional experience developing a variety of web-based applications using React and developed Rest APIs using NodeJS and Springboot. I have created advanced data visualization apps capable of interacting with REST API and Web sockets. I’m a quick learner, and I have no problem picking up new technologies necessary to accomplish my new challenges.
